ModuleMeta.Name: Shipping Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Shipping DDD domain: Shipments with status workflow (pending→ready→shipped→delivered) and domain events, ShippingMethods with zone-based availability, and ShippingRates with computed pricing by method and zone.

Principle.name: Shipment as Aggregate Root
Principle.Description: Shipment tracks physical shipping independently from order; each shipment has its own status workflow.
Principle.Rationale: An order may have multiple shipments (split fulfillment).

Principle.name: Tracking Required Before Ship
Principle.Description: Shipment requires tracking number before transitioning to shipped status.
Principle.Rationale: Ensures every shipped package is traceable.

Feature.name: Shipment Aggregate
Feature.Description: Shipment with status workflow, tracking number, carrier, and domain events.

Feature.name: Shipping Methods
Feature.Description: Available shipping methods with zone definitions and activate/deactivate.

Feature.name: Shipping Rates
Feature.Description: Computed rates by method and zone for checkout quoting.

Abstraction.name: Shipment
Abstraction.Description: Shipment aggregate with status workflow and domain events.
Abstraction.Purpose: Track physical package delivery from warehouse to customer.

Abstraction.name: ShippingMethod
Abstraction.Purpose: Available shipping options for customers at checkout.

Abstraction.name: ShippingRate
Abstraction.Description: Computed shipping rate by method, zone, and cart weight/price.
Abstraction.Purpose: Dynamic shipping cost calculation at checkout.

AntiPattern.name: Ship Without Tracking
AntiPattern.Avoid: Marking shipment as shipped without a tracking number.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Validate tracking number is set before transitioning to shipped status.
